jobs.title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (gn)
jobs.description: Einleitung  Du möchtest nicht nur Cloud-Infrastrukturen betreiben, sondern die Azure-Landschaft eines international tätigen Unternehmens aktiv weiterentwickeln? Du schätzt technische Verantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Team, das Herausforderungen gemeinsam angeht? Dann könnte diese Position genau zu dir passen. Für ein wirtschaftlich erfolgreiches Unternehmen mit Sitz in Hamburg suche ich einen erfahrenen Azure Cloud Engineer (gn), der Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung der Azure-Plattform übernimmt und seine Ideen aktiv einbringen möchte. Dich erwartet ein modernes IT-Umfeld mit einer hohen Investitionsbereitschaft in Cloud-Technologien, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und einer Unternehmenskultur, die von Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und Zusammenarbeit geprägt ist.   Deine Aufgaben    Du verantwortest den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der konzernweiten Microsoft-Azure-Umgebung (IaaS, PaaS und SaaS).  Du bringst deine Ideen bei der Weiterentwicklung der Cloud-Strategie ein und gestaltest technische Entscheidungen aktiv mit.  Du bewertest neue Technologien, Architekturen und Migrationsszenarien und entwickelst zukunftsfähige Betriebskonzepte.  Du stellst sicher, dass Security-, Governance- und Compliance-Anforderungen in der Cloud berücksichtigt werden.  Du analysierst Performance und Verfügbarkeit der Cloud-Services und optimierst diese kontinuierlich.  Du unterstützt deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei technischen Fragestellungen und bringst dein Know-how in spannende Infrastrukturprojekte ein.     Dein Profil    Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau, Betrieb oder der Weiterentwicklung von Microsoft-Azure-Umgebungen  Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Cloud-Infrastrukturen sowie der Azure-Plattform  Erfahrung mit Cloud-Architekturen sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Security-, Governance- und Infrastrukturthemen  Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise  Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam im Team nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln  Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse     Benefits    Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten  Ein erfahrenes Team, das Wissen teilt, sich gegenseitig unterstützt und Herausforderungen gemeinsam meistert  Eine wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Vertrauen und offener Kommunikation  Individuelle fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung mit langfristigen Entwicklungsperspektiven  Moderne Technologien und abwechslungsreiche Projekte in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld  Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit, an 2 bis 4 Tagen pro Woche remote zu arbeiten  37,5-Stunden-Woche  Bis zu 35 Urlaubstage  Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bike Leasing, Kostenlose Parkplätze, Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, u.v.m. jobs.title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer
jobs.description: About A1   There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.  Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.   About the Role   As an ML Platform Engineer, you will build the infrastructure and systems that power A1's AI capabilities.  You will design and operate the systems behind the AI stack, from model training and evaluation to deployment, inference, observability, and continuous improvement.  You will work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and product engineers to turn models into reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient production systems. You will build the platforms, tooling, and infrastructure that enable the team to experiment quickly and bring AI capabilities to production with confidence.   Focus     Build and operate the ML infrastructure and platforms powering A1’s AI products    Design systems for model training, evaluation, deployment, inference, and experimentation    Build and optimise model serving and inference infrastructure for high-throughput and low-latency workloads    Improve reliability, scalability, latency, and cost efficiency of AI systems    Develop reliable pipelines for data preparation, training, evaluation, model release, and continuous improvement    Build platforms and tooling that enable AI engineers and researchers to experiment, evaluate, and ship models faster    Develop evaluation and benchmarking infrastructure to measure model quality, performance, and regressions    Build production observability, monitoring, tracing, and alerting for AI/ML workloads    Improve AI systems across reliability, scalability, latency, throughput, and cost    Identify bottlenecks across the ML stack and continuously improve system performance    Work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and product teams to turn evolving model requirements into production-ready infrastructure     Tech Stack     Python    PyTorch / JAX    LLM and ML serving infrastructure such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM    Cloud infrastructure    Distributed systems    ML/data pipelines and workflow orchestration    GPU infrastructure and performance tooling    Vector databases and retrieval infrastructure     Ideal Experience     Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems    Experience building ML infrastructure, platforms, or production machine learning systems    Experience with model deployment, inference, evaluation, or data pipelines    Strong understanding of distributed systems and system reliability    Ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code    Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments    Bias toward ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement     Outcomes     AI infrastructure reliably supports production workloads at scale    Models can be trained, evaluated, deployed, and improved efficiently    Inference systems deliver strong latency, throughput, reliability, and cost efficiency    ML pipelines are reproducible, observable, maintainable, and robust    Model and infrastructure regressions are detected quickly and diagnosed efficiently    Common ML infrastructure capabilities become reusable platform primitives rather than being rebuilt for every AI product    The AI stack can evolve rapidly as new models, architectures, jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.  The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.   At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.  As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you'll build and evolve the data foundation that powers Choco's internal analytics, AI capabilities, and customer-facing data products. As we scale to serve increasingly demanding enterprise customers, our data platform needs to meet higher standards for reliability, freshness, quality, and compliance. You'll own critical parts of our ingestion, transformation, and data platform ecosystem-helping us move toward enterprise-grade SLAs while making it easier for teams across Choco to build trustworthy data products.   This isn't a role focused purely on pipelines. You'll own problems end-to-end, from understanding why they matter to designing, shipping, operating, and driving adoption of scalable solutions.    What you'll do     Design and build a scalable data platform, from ingestion frameworks to the data products consumers rely on.    Build and operate batch, streaming, and CDC pipelines across heterogeneous data sources.    Deepen data observability and establish SLA/SLO frameworks around reliability, freshness, quality, and downstream impact.    Implement PII masking, retention, and data contracts that make compliance and governance part of the platform by design.    Improve data modeling, warehouse/lakehouse standards, and developer productivity through reusable tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows.    Lead technical initiatives from architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation.    Make pragmatic engineering decisions balancing scalability, reliability, cost, and business priorities.    Help prepare Choco's data platform for the next stage of enterprise-scale growth.     What you bring     5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or similar roles, with ownership of production data systems in a SaaS, fast-paced environment.    Strong experience building distributed data pipelines using technologies such as Spark/Databricks, dbt, Airflow, SQL, and Python.    Experience with streaming/CDC, heterogeneous data ingestion, and modern lakehouse or warehouse architectures.    Hands-on experience with data quality, observability, governance, and infrastructure-as-code followed by strong system design and technical judgement, with a track record of owning complex problems from discovery through production.    Clear communication and the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.    Experience with Kafka/Kinesis/Debezium or supporting ML/AI workloads in production is a plus.    What you get    Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.    Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.    Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.    In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work,  including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).
